title: clerodendrum silvanum f. caulanthum
intro: Clerodendrum silvanum f. caulanthum, commonly known as a variety of the Clerodendrum silvanum plant, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum silvanum f. caulanthum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include clerodendrin, clerodendric acid, and other iridoid compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
